title: Foresaken lore
description: This mod is a Foresaken Crowns Lore Addon, adding a Lore Page that tells you about each of Forsaken Crown's Bosses and their possible drops.
body:
### The Forsaken Crown

The forsaken crown beneath the dust of kingdoms lost,
where shattered thrones lie cold as frost,
seven rulers, bound in woe, 
dwell in graves where echoes grow.
 
Their kingdoms fell to time’s embrace, stone to ruin, gold erased.
Yet in their crowns,
their curse remains—
power drowned in sorrow’s chains.
 
The Ashen King, 
of wrath and fire and sword ablaze,
a fate most dire.
His kingdom burned, his fury stayed,
now embers walk where shadows fade.
 
The Frostbitten Matron, 
cold and still her palace drowned in ice’s will.
She sleeps beneath the frozen deep,
her heart as numb as those who weep.
 
The Hollow Tyrant,
Prideful king who lost his rule but kept his ring.
His golden touch now turns to dust,
Amonarch drowned by broken trust.
 
The Drowned Empress,
A greedy soul who sank beneath the tide’s control.
Her wealth lies deep,
Yet none may claim—
The sea itself now speaks her name.
 
The Iron Husk,
Of envy’s bligh this iron heart still grips with might,
He sought to steal, to take, to own—
Now rust consumes his hollow throne.
 
The Scourge,
A maw unfed a gluttonous corpse,
A hunger spread.
What once was flesh,
now feast for flies,
yet still his hollow belly cries.
 
The Silver Ghost,
Of lustful lies who danced in moonlight,
Lured with sighs.
Yet beauty fades,
And so did he,
Now lost with in eternity.
 
Their crowns lie waiting,
Whispering still,
A promise sweet,
A bitter thrill.
Take their power,
Take their might—
But bear the curse,
And fear the night.
 
For those who seek the forsaken crown,
Take it,
But thou shalt be dragged down.

# Forsaken Lore
This mod is a Foresaken Crowns Lore Addon, adding a Lore Page that tells you about each of Forsaken Crown's Bosses and their possible drops.
To Obtain the Lore Page, you must Stonecut a Written Book.
